requirements.text: Run HermiT OWLReasoner.isConsistent over the complete merged OWL 2 DL ontology after Phase 40.5 qualification.
Emit deterministic consistency evidence bound to dataset, snapshot, ontology inputs, OWL signature, datatype policy, profile qualification and reasoner version.
Bind the reasoner report and immutable snapshot to the exact consistency qualification SHA-256 and independently verify it in Rust.
Reject publication for inconsistent ontologies and never substitute per-graph or arbitrary partition consistency for the global merged decision.
Require complete checksum-bound input coverage and match loaded ontology/axiom counts to the Phase 40.5 qualification evidence.
Provide strict JSON Schema, independent validator, positive/negative fixtures and Java/Rust regression coverage.
Preserve Phase 40.5 ancestry and cumulative gates without claiming Direct-BGP legality, arbitrary exact fallback or full OWL Direct completeness.
